name: VS Code Copilot Chat agent mode

system_prompt_style.note: Doc mentions 'The Chat Debug view shows the raw system prompt' and custom instructions exist, but no mechanism of prompt construction; only a docs page available.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: VS Code automatically includes the active file, your current selection, and the file name as context. When you use agents, the agent decides autonomously if additional context is needed.
env_context_strategy.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Add context to your prompts
env_context_strategy.note: Implicit active-file injection plus agent-decided context; #codebase retrieval mechanism unspecified. Closest value mixed.

context_compaction.note: Docs page only; no config surface on history compaction.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Media files from tool results (such as the integrated browser, Playwright, or other MCP servers) and inlined in assistant messages are all accessible from the carousel.
observation_format.note: Command output appears as text; images from tool results. Whether images are fed to model not explicit.

tool_call_format.note: No parser or call format described.

tool_count.note: No tool list in evidence; only #fetch named.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: connect MCP servers or install extensions that contribute tools to give the agent access to external services, databases, or APIs.
tool_schema_source.note: Only MCP source evidenced; built-in tool schema source not reported.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: connect MCP servers or install extensions that contribute tools to give the agent access to external services, databases, or APIs.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent can answer questions, analyze your code, run tools, make changes, and respond with a summary.
loop_primitives.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Send a chat request

multi_agent_topology.note: Custom agents and 'agent role' mentioned but topology not described.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Each session has configuration options that shape how the agent responds, such as the agent harness, agent role, permission level, and language model.
human_in_loop.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Send a chat request
human_in_loop.note: chat.notifyWindowOnConfirmation: 'when the agent needs your input or confirmation to continue'. Steering mid-run also possible.

long_term_memory.note: Custom instructions, prompt files and agent skills mentioned; persistence semantics across runs not described.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: You can run multiple sessions in parallel and switch between them without losing context.
state_persistence.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Send a chat request
state_persistence.note: Inferred from session switching; interrupted-run resume not explicit.

rollback.evidence_quote: To restore affected workspace files and chat history, restore a checkpoint. Checkpoints don't reverse changes to external services.
rollback.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Send messages while a request is running

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The command runs immediately in the session's default shell, without sending the message to the agent or asking for approval.
execution_isolation.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Run terminal commands from chat
execution_isolation.note: Describes user ! commands in Agent Host sessions; agent isolation not explicit.

filesystem_access.note: Worktree working directory mentioned; access limits not described.

permission_model.evidence_quote: configure when you receive an OS notification when the agent needs your input or confirmation to continue.
permission_model.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Get notified about chat responses
permission_model.note: Permission level configurable per session; default level not stated.

tracing.evidence_quote: Agent Logs shows a chronological event log of tool calls, LLM requests, and prompt file discovery.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Ask questions about your code, get help understanding complex logic, generate new features, fix bugs, and more, all through a conversational interface.
target_domain.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Use chat in VS Code
target_domain.note: web from integrated browser/Playwright; general_tool_use from MCP.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Each session has configuration options that shape how the agent responds, such as the agent harness, agent role, permission level, and language model.
model_agnostic.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Send a chat request
model_agnostic.note: Model selectable; provider breadth not stated.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Chat in Visual Studio Code lets you use natural language for interacting with AI agents.
primary_artifact.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Use chat in VS Code
primary_artifact.note: Only product documentation available; closest value tech_report.

pinned_version.note: No version or repo; doc dated 9/16/2026.
